Senses.Explanation: Climbing a tree to seek fish marks effort directed where its object cannot be found. Fenyang, Jingyin, Yongming, and Kaifu use the image in verse and instruction; Zhongfeng develops it in his own exposition, while Qingshan applies it to the Yunju–Dongshan encounter.
